page.overview:
What is Storm Sword?

The Storm Sword is Rain's weapon of choice in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon. It is a single-edged, curved sword made of bronze and has the emblem from Rain's cape etched into the blade itself. It also has a tusk as its pommel.
